chunks: How can a warning benefit them? The Apostle who explained all things clearly had come to them,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'How can a warning benefit them' in Surah Ad-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question highlights the finality of divine proof; since the Messenger arrived with clear, undeniable guidance, further 'reminder' (dhikra) becomes redundant for those who persist in denial. It underscores the concept of *khatm al-hujjah* (sealing of the argument), where the arrival of the Prophet serves as the ultimate confirmation, rendering subsequent reminders ineffective for the stubborn disbelievers of Mecca.
